weekly.title: Nearly 3% of Cloud Customer Data Permanently Lost After Drone Strikes, Yandex Says
weekly.summary: The tech company attributed the data loss to “critical damage to equipment” and a failure by some cloud customers to maintain external backups on the platform.

weekly.title: Freight Train Derails in Arkhangelsk Region Following Bridge Collapse
weekly.summary: At least eight long-distance passenger trains traveling between major cities — including Moscow and St. Petersburg — were left stranded following the derailment.
